businesses.business: Sleep and respiratory devices and healthcare software

offering_description.value: ResMed develops cloud-connected devices for people with sleep apnea, COPD and other respiratory conditions. Its home sleep tests let providers screen patients remotely, and its software helps healthcare teams manage care outside hospitals.

quotes.quote: We’re leading the way in cloud-connected medical devices that transform care for people with sleep apnea, COPD and other chronic diseases. Our comprehensive out-of-hospital software platforms support the professionals and caregivers who help people stay healthy in the home or care setting of their choice.

Resmed diagnostic solutions are designed to help the millions of undiagnosed sleep apnea patients get answers they need, and the treatment they deserve so they can rest. Our Home Sleep Tests (HSTs) empower providers to screen more patients and manage each step of the diagnostic process.
